=== case basic-set-list
--- kind
batch
--- input
set t.lan.proto=dhcp
set t.lan.ip="10.0.0.1"
add_list t.lan.dns=9.9.9.9
del_list t.lan.dns=1.1.1.1
--- show
t.lan=iface
t.lan.proto='dhcp'
t.lan.dns='8.8.8.8' '9.9.9.9'
t.lan.ip='10.0.0.1'
t.@rule[0]=rule
t.@rule[0].name='r0'
t.@rule[1]=rule
t.@rule[1].name='r1'
--- committed

config iface 'lan'
	option proto 'dhcp'
	list dns '8.8.8.8'
	list dns '9.9.9.9'
	option ip '10.0.0.1'

config rule
	option name 'r0'

config rule
	option name 'r1'

=== end
=== case anonymous-add-rename-reorder
--- kind
batch
--- input
add t rule
set t.@rule[-1].name=new
set t.@rule[0].name=zero
rename t.@rule[1]=second
reorder t.second=0
--- show
t.second=rule
t.second.name='r1'
t.lan=iface
t.lan.proto='static'
t.lan.dns='1.1.1.1' '8.8.8.8'
t.@rule[1]=rule
t.@rule[1].name='zero'
t.@rule[2]=rule
t.@rule[2].name='new'
--- committed

config rule 'second'
	option name 'r1'

config iface 'lan'
	option proto 'static'
	list dns '1.1.1.1'
	list dns '8.8.8.8'

config rule
	option name 'zero'

config rule
	option name 'new'

=== end
=== case delete-forms
--- kind
batch
--- input
delete t.lan.dns=1
delete t.lan.proto
delete t.@rule[0]
--- show
t.lan=iface
t.lan.dns='1.1.1.1'
t.@rule[0]=rule
t.@rule[0].name='r1'
--- committed

config iface 'lan'
	list dns '1.1.1.1'

config rule
	option name 'r1'

=== end
=== case type-change-new-section
--- kind
batch
--- input
set t.lan=iface2
set t.fresh=thing
set t.fresh.a=1
rename t.fresh.a=b
--- show
t.lan=iface2
t.lan.proto='static'
t.lan.dns='1.1.1.1' '8.8.8.8'
t.@rule[0]=rule
t.@rule[0].name='r0'
t.@rule[1]=rule
t.@rule[1].name='r1'
t.fresh=thing
t.fresh.b='1'
--- committed

config iface2 'lan'
	option proto 'static'
	list dns '1.1.1.1'
	list dns '8.8.8.8'

config rule
	option name 'r0'

config rule
	option name 'r1'

config thing 'fresh'
	option b '1'

=== end
=== case failures-go-on
--- kind
batch
--- input
set t.lan.m1=1
set t.nope.x=2
bogus x
set t.lan.m3=3
set t.lan.n
rename t.lan=
--- show
t.lan=iface
t.lan.proto='static'
t.lan.dns='1.1.1.1' '8.8.8.8'
t.lan.m1='1'
t.lan.m3='3'
t.@rule[0]=rule
t.@rule[0].name='r0'
t.@rule[1]=rule
t.@rule[1].name='r1'
--- committed

config iface 'lan'
	option proto 'static'
	list dns '1.1.1.1'
	list dns '8.8.8.8'
	option m1 '1'
	option m3 '3'

config rule
	option name 'r0'

config rule
	option name 'r1'

=== end
=== case quoting-comments-semicolon
--- kind
batch
--- input
# c

  set t.lan.msg="hello world"
set t.lan.q='it'\''s'  # trailing
set t.lan.a=1; set t.lan.b=2
set t.lan.c="1"; set t.lan.d=2
set t.lan.e=3
--- show
t.lan=iface
t.lan.proto='static'
t.lan.dns='1.1.1.1' '8.8.8.8'
t.lan.msg='hello world'
t.lan.q='it'\''s'
t.lan.a='1'
t.lan.c='1'
t.lan.e='3'
t.@rule[0]=rule
t.@rule[0].name='r0'
t.@rule[1]=rule
t.@rule[1].name='r1'
--- committed

config iface 'lan'
	option proto 'static'
	list dns '1.1.1.1'
	list dns '8.8.8.8'
	option msg 'hello world'
	option q 'it'\''s'
	option a '1'
	option c '1'
	option e '3'

config rule
	option name 'r0'

config rule
	option name 'r1'

=== end
=== case empty-set-deletes
--- kind
batch
--- input
set t.lan.proto=
set t.lan.nothing=
--- show
t.lan=iface
t.lan.dns='1.1.1.1' '8.8.8.8'
t.@rule[0]=rule
t.@rule[0].name='r0'
t.@rule[1]=rule
t.@rule[1].name='r1'
--- committed

config iface 'lan'
	list dns '1.1.1.1'
	list dns '8.8.8.8'

config rule
	option name 'r0'

config rule
	option name 'r1'

=== end
=== case list-single-conversions
--- kind
batch
--- input
set t.lan.dns=single
add_list t.lan.proto=more
add_list t.lan.fresh=x
--- show
t.lan=iface
t.lan.proto='static' 'more'
t.lan.dns='single'
t.lan.fresh='x'
t.@rule[0]=rule
t.@rule[0].name='r0'
t.@rule[1]=rule
t.@rule[1].name='r1'
--- committed

config iface 'lan'
	list proto 'static'
	list proto 'more'
	option dns 'single'
	list fresh 'x'

config rule
	option name 'r0'

config rule
	option name 'r1'

=== end
=== case del-list-last-entry
--- kind
batch
--- input
del_list t.lan.dns=1.1.1.1
del_list t.lan.dns=8.8.8.8
add_list t.lan.k=a
del_list t.lan.k=a
--- show
t.lan=iface
t.lan.proto='static'
t.lan.dns=
t.lan.k=
t.@rule[0]=rule
t.@rule[0].name='r0'
t.@rule[1]=rule
t.@rule[1].name='r1'
--- committed

config iface 'lan'
	option proto 'static'

config rule
	option name 'r0'

config rule
	option name 'r1'

=== end
=== case commit-in-script
--- kind
batch
--- input
set t.lan.x=1
commit t
set t.lan.y=2
--- show
t.lan=iface
t.lan.proto='static'
t.lan.dns='1.1.1.1' '8.8.8.8'
t.lan.x='1'
t.lan.y='2'
t.@rule[0]=rule
t.@rule[0].name='r0'
t.@rule[1]=rule
t.@rule[1].name='r1'
--- committed

config iface 'lan'
	option proto 'static'
	list dns '1.1.1.1'
	list dns '8.8.8.8'
	option x '1'
	option y '2'

config rule
	option name 'r0'

config rule
	option name 'r1'

=== end
=== case revert-in-script
--- kind
batch
--- input
set t.lan.x=1
revert t
set t.lan.y=2
--- show
t.lan=iface
t.lan.proto='static'
t.lan.dns='1.1.1.1' '8.8.8.8'
t.lan.y='2'
t.@rule[0]=rule
t.@rule[0].name='r0'
t.@rule[1]=rule
t.@rule[1].name='r1'
--- committed

config iface 'lan'
	option proto 'static'
	list dns '1.1.1.1'
	list dns '8.8.8.8'
	option y '2'

config rule
	option name 'r0'

config rule
	option name 'r1'

=== end
=== case merge-list-single-anon
--- kind
import
--- input
config iface 'lan'
	list dns '9.9.9.9'
	option proto 'dhcp'
	option fresh '1'

config rule
	option name 'r9'

config other 'o1'
	option k 'v'
--- show
t.lan=iface
t.lan.proto='dhcp'
t.lan.dns='1.1.1.1' '8.8.8.8' '9.9.9.9'
t.lan.fresh='1'
t.@rule[0]=rule
t.@rule[0].name='r0'
t.@rule[1]=rule
t.@rule[1].name='r1'
t.@rule[2]=rule
t.@rule[2].name='r9'
t.o1=other
t.o1.k='v'
--- committed

config iface 'lan'
	option proto 'dhcp'
	list dns '1.1.1.1'
	list dns '8.8.8.8'
	list dns '9.9.9.9'
	option fresh '1'

config rule
	option name 'r0'

config rule
	option name 'r1'

config rule
	option name 'r9'

config other 'o1'
	option k 'v'

=== end
=== case merge-single-over-list
--- kind
import
--- input
config iface 'lan'
	option dns 'single'
	list proto 'p1'
	list proto 'p2'
--- show
t.lan=iface
t.lan.proto='static' 'p1' 'p2'
t.lan.dns='single'
t.@rule[0]=rule
t.@rule[0].name='r0'
t.@rule[1]=rule
t.@rule[1].name='r1'
--- committed

config iface 'lan'
	list proto 'static'
	list proto 'p1'
	list proto 'p2'
	option dns 'single'

config rule
	option name 'r0'

config rule
	option name 'r1'

=== end
=== case merge-type-clash
--- kind
import
--- input
config xx 'lan'
	option a 'b'
--- show
t.lan=iface
t.lan.proto='static'
t.lan.dns='1.1.1.1' '8.8.8.8'
t.@rule[0]=rule
t.@rule[0].name='r0'
t.@rule[1]=rule
t.@rule[1].name='r1'
--- committed
config iface 'lan'
	option proto 'static'
	list dns '1.1.1.1'
	list dns '8.8.8.8'

config rule
	option name 'r0'

config rule
	option name 'r1'
=== end
